purpose: Bounded diagnostic scene-scale and artificial-boundary counterfactuals, not a trained or selected candidate
resize: Bilinear align_corners=False; antialias=True for downsampling; resized dimensions rounded to multiples of eight
interpretation: Scene scaling changes image frequency and effective context together. Matched residual resampling and mean matching separate some effects but cannot establish global-context causality. No inference/postprocessor adoption or training decision from aggregate metrics alone.
budget: Exactly three diagnostic cases: one native, one aligned center crop and one reduced-scene forward each (nine total). No training, selection or final evaluation.
